text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios full-on sprints, but falls 
short. And once again... Daiichi Ruby 
fails to produce a result worthy of her 
"clan."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her head is completely full of future 
plans, basically. Yep, Daitaku Helios is 
totally out of the picture. FR FR?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
'Ain't hyped enough? Gotta polish my 
party-people vibes!' And so, she set her 
next goal on the Yasuda Kinen trial race— 
the Milers Cup.
